title: vit.ac.in
description: VIT (Vellore Institute of Technology, official site vit.ac.in) is a well-known private university in India: founded in 1984 and granted university status in 2001, with its main campus in Vellore and additional campuses in Chennai, AP, and Bhopal; it is especially strong in engineering and technology (NAAC A++, solid NIRF/QS standing), admits most undergrads via VITEEE, and posts strong placements (often 10,000+ offers in recent years, with top packages around 1 crore INR).
